note: 4.1.1 樣本題庫（starter）：單選／克漏字（5 題一組）／文意選填。正式題庫將由考題語料庫管線（4.0.1）結構化擴充。

single.q: The scientist conducted a series of ______ to test her hypothesis.
single.explanation: conduct a series of experiments 為固定搭配（conduct＝進行、策畫）；句末 to test her hypothesis（測試她的假設）決定了要用實驗。ceremonies（典禮）、declarations（宣言）、appointments（任命）都不可能用來「測試假設」。

single.q: Regular exercise can significantly ______ the risk of heart disease.
single.explanation: risk 只能被 reduce（大幅降低），不會被 increase（增加）；significantly 加強了變化的幅度。ignore（忽略）與 replace（取代）跟風險都沒有搭配關係。

single.q: Despite the heavy rain, the construction workers continued their tasks without ______.
single.explanation: without 後接單數名詞，表示「在沒有…的情況下」；Despite the heavy rain 與 continued their tasks 呼應的是不被打斷地繼續工作，故用 interruption（中斷）。complaint（抱怨）、celebration（慶祝）、permission（許可）都不是此意。

single.q: The government has ______ new regulations to protect endangered species.
single.explanation: 法規政策常用 implement（實施、施行），to protect endangered species 說明新規定已經上路。translated（翻譯）、postponed forever（永遠延後）、forgotten（被遺忘）都不符「訂定並施行」的語意。

single.q: Her ______ explanation left the audience more confused than before.
single.explanation: more confused（更困惑）呼應 vague（模糊的），前後語意一致。clear（清楚的）與 confused 相反；detailed（詳細的）、careful（仔細的）都不會讓聽眾更困惑。

single.q: The novel was so ______ that I finished it in one sitting.
single.explanation: so ___ that…（如此…以至於）加上 finished it in one sitting（一口氣讀完）表示小說引人入勝，故用 gripping。boring（無聊的）、lengthy（冗長的）、complicated（複雜的）都無法解釋一氣呵成。

single.q: To stay healthy, you should ______ processed foods as much as possible.
single.explanation: To stay healthy（為了維持健康）指向 avoid（避免）加工食品。consume（食用）、preserve（保存）、donate（捐贈）都與維持健康的語意相反。

single.q: The manager ______ the importance of teamwork during the meeting.
single.explanation: emphasize the importance of（強調…的重要性）為固定搭配，during the meeting 符合會上發言的場合。denied（否認）、postponed（延後）、cancelled（取消）都不合場合。

single.q: Regular exercise is ______ to good health; without it, the risk of heart disease rises sharply.
single.explanation: essential ＝不可或缺的、基本的，後面接 to 構成 be essential to。分號後的 without it…rising sharply 反證前面必須是不可或缺。optional（可選的）、excessive（過多的）、efficient（高效率的）都不構成「少了就不健康」的語意。

single.q: Walking to school instead of taking a car can also ______ to a reduction in air pollution.
single.explanation: contribute to ＝「有助於、造成（某結果）」，與後面的 a reduction 形成因果。consume（消耗／吃完）與 contain（包含）都不能直接接 to 表達貢獻；consist 固定搭配是 consist of（由…組成），接 to 語法不成立。

single.q: Using ______ amounts of fertilizer may contaminate the soil and harm the food chain.
single.explanation: 後果 contaminate the soil and harm the food chain（污染土壤、危害食物鏈）指向「用量過多」，故用 excessive（過多的）。essential（必要的）、virtual（虛擬的）、genuine（真實的）都與「過量」無關。

single.q: ______ the heavy traffic, the shop on the corner is always crowded at lunchtime.
single.explanation: 句意是讓步：雖然交通壅塞，店裡午餐時依然人潮拥挤。despite 是介系詞，後接名詞 the heavy traffic，語法與語意皆正確。although 雖也可接子句但後面必須是子句（不能直接接名詞片語）；because 表原因、unless 表條件，與讓步語意相反。

single.q: The shop sells ______ kinds of tea, from green to black.
single.explanation: from green to black 暗示種類很多，用 various（各種各樣的）修飾複數名詞 kinds。valuable（有價值的）、virtual（虛擬的）、likely（可能的）都不表「種類繁多」。

single.q: In some villages, families still ______ traditional recipes and pass them on to the next generation.
single.explanation: 與 pass them on to the next generation（傳給下一代）呼應的是「保存、延續」，故用 preserve（保存、維護）。prevent 防止、pretend 假裝、present 呈現／現在的，語意都不成立。

single.q: The view from the top of the mountain is so ______ that tourists rarely forget it.
single.explanation: so … that ＋ rarely forget（很少忘記）帶正面讚嘆，需用 impressive（令人印象深刻的）。excessive（過多的）、optional（可選的）、sufficient（足夠的）都無法構成令人難忘的語意。

single.q: The new lighting system in the hall is far more ______ than the old one, using only a third of the electricity.
single.explanation: using only a third of the electricity（只用三分之一的電）是節能數據，與 far more ___ than 構成比較，故用 efficient（有效率的）。expensive 是價格、excessive 是數量過多、optional 是可選的，都不能解釋省電。

single.q: The city decided to ______ a fine on drivers who park in front of the school gate.
single.explanation: impose a fine on … 是「對…罰款」的固定搭配，impose ＝ 把（稅金、處罰）強加於。impress（留下印象）、expose（使暴露）、dispose（處置）都沒有「加諸他人身上」的語意。

single.q: The difference between the two groups was ______: one used public transport every day, while the other drove a car.
single.explanation: 分號後強烈對比兩組的通勤方式，表示差異很大，故用 significant（顯著的、重要的）。specific（特定的）、sufficient（充足的）、sensible（明智的）都沒有「差異大」的語意。

single.q: Children who are ______ to a new environment often adapt more slowly than those raised in big cities.
single.explanation: be resistant to ＝「對…有抵抗力的」，後接 new environment 與後面 adapt more slowly（適應較慢）互相呼應。relative（相對的）、respectable（值得尊敬的）、responsible（負責任的）都放不進 be ___ to 的這個句型。

single.q: Screen time has a strong ______ on teenagers' sleep; the more they scroll at night, the later they fall asleep.
single.explanation: have an impact on … 是固定搭配，指「對…造成影響」。impulse 衝動、import 進口、impression 印象都不能與 have a strong ___ on 搭配。
